chunks: Has news of the Overpowering Event reached you?

key_terms.الْغَاشِيَةِ: The Overpowering Event / The Overwhelming (referring to the Day of Judgment or the fate of disbelievers)

ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of 'Hadith al-Ghashiyah' in the Quran?
ai.summary: This rhetorical question, 'Has there reached you the news of the Overwhelming?', serves as a powerful hook in Meccan revelation, emphasizing the certainty of the Day of Judgment to the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family). In Shia exegesis, this verse is often linked to the concept of *Tadkhir* (warning) and is seen as a precursor to the detailed descriptions of divine justice, reinforcing the inevitability of the Hereafter for both the disbelievers and the righteous.
